review_candidates.title: Product Manager
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Nabat is a climate-tech startup based in the UAE using advanced technology to protect and restore natural ecosystems with precision and scale. We operate at the intersection of ecological and environmental sciences, GIS, AI, remote sensing, and robotics . Our mission is to enable data-driven, science-backed ecosystem management and restoration at the speed and scale necessary to address the critical challenges of climate change, deforestation, land erosion, and biodiversity loss. Our comprehensive solution -consisting of ecosystem management software, precision aerial seeding drones, AI and ecological models, and restoration services is already being used to plant millions of mangroves in the UAE. But we’re just getting started. We’re building our platform to serve the needs of coastal, marine, and arid ecosystems around the world. If this mission resonates with you, let’s talk. We’re building our product development team from the ground up and are looking for a talented, self-driven Product Manager to help build and scale Nabat’s next generation of AI-powered products. This is a technical and domain-focused product role . You will work closely with our Data Scientists, GIS Specialists, SW/HW Engineers, Ecologists and commercial teams to turn complex technologies and scientific capabilities into products that solve real customer problems. We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience in one or more domains relevant to Nabat , including geospatial/GIS, climate or nature tech, agriculture/agtech, remote sensing/Earth observation, or AI/ML products. Relocation to the UAE is required — generous relocation benefits and visa sponsorship for the employee and their family will be provided. Your Responsibilities Will Include Own the product roadmap and execution for Nabat’s AI-powered ecosystem management and restoration products Work closely with engineering, operations, commercial and customers to turn complex technology into valuable, scalable products Lead product discovery by understanding customer needs, validating opportunities, and prioritizing what to build Translate technical and scientific concepts into clear product requirements, priorities, and success metrics Take products from concept through launch and iteration, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and business impact Identify emerging technologies, datasets, and partnerships that could create new product opportunities Build strong relationships with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to shape product direction and drive adoption What are we looking for? 3+ years of product management experience, ideally in a technology, data, AI, or other technically complex environment Proven experience taking products from conception through launch, including requirements, prioritization, and roadmap development Domain experience in at least one of: geospatial/GIS, climate or nature tech, agriculture/agtech, remote sensing/Earth observation, or AI/ML products Strong technical fluency and the ability to work effectively with engineers, AI/ML researchers, and other technical experts Experience with B2B products and customer discovery, with a strong understanding of how to identify and validate customer needs Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Science, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience A genuine passion for applying technology to climate, nature, agriculture, and other high-impact real-world challenges Why join Nabat? A Once-in-a-lifetime Opportunity To Join a well-funded early-stage tech startup at the intersection of some of the most exciting, disruptive, and innovative technologies in the world — geospatial AI, remote sensing, drone robotics, ecology, and agricultural science Design, build, and shape products from the ground up, using your unique skills and expertise Work with a truly international and world-class R&D team both within Nabat and in collaboration with 1,200+ researchers, scientists, and technologists in the larger Advanced Technology Research Council, Technology Innovation Institute, and VentureOne ecosystem Relocate to Abu Dhabi — one of the safest, most livable, and expat-friendly cities in the world — with an “all-inclusive” relocation package for you and your family, including work and residence visa sponsorship, relocation flights, orientation tour, school and house search, and hotel stay until you find your new home Make a real and direct impact on solving some of the most critical challenges of our time — climate change, ecosystem loss, biodiversity loss, and food security What is the hiring process like? We believe in making your hiring and onboarding seamless and transparent. Here is what to expect from us: Initial screening call with a member of our Talent team to ensure expectations and experience align First interview with the hiring manager about the role, your experience, and your questions — Taha Ghaznavi, Chief Product Officer, Nabat Second interview with technical and product team members to assess your product thinking, technical fluency, and ability to work with domain experts. Third interview with a senior leader to assess culture fit and give you an opportunity to meet future stakeholders Security clearance and final offer Relocation to the UAE and onboarding Apply with your CV and tell us what makes you — and your combination of product, technical, and domain experience — a great fit for Nabat. How To Apply Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with Nabat? To apply, please send your resume detailing your relevant experience and why you're the perfect fit for this role. At Nabat, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping the future of sustainable agriculture through innovation and collaboration. If you’re passionate about making a real-world impact and working alongside a diverse team of curious minds, we’d love to hear from you. Join us in transforming data into solutions that matter.

review_candidates.description: The Procurement Executive manages end-to-end sourcing, purchasing, and vendor relationships for the school. This role ensures all academic departments, administrative offices, and facility teams receive high-quality goods and services on time while optimizing operational costs and adhering to educational standards and compliance policies. Key Responsibilities Purchasing & Operations: Process Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and Purchase Orders (POs) for academic resources, IT hardware/software, lab equipment, furniture, and facility maintenance supplies. Vendor & Supplier Management: Identify, evaluate, and maintain a robust database of qualified suppliers. Negotiate pricing, credit terms, and service level agreements (SLAs) to secure optimal value. Tender & Bid Evaluation: Assist in managing competitive bidding, RFQs, and RFPs for major school contracts (e.g., catering, school transport, security, cleaning, uniforms, and textbooks). Cross-Departmental Support: Work closely with Academic Heads, IT, and Facilities teams to understand procurement needs, clarify technical specifications, and ensure alignment with budget cycles. Budget & Cost Control: Monitor procurement spending against department budgets, identify cost-saving opportunities, and provide periodic expense tracking reports to Finance. Inventory & Asset Control: Coordinate with storekeepers or facility staff to monitor stock levels, manage asset tagging, and ensure proper record-keeping for incoming deliveries. Compliance & Ethics: Ensure all purchasing activities comply with school governance policies, local import/export regulations (for imported educational materials), and ethical sourcing standards. Requirements & Qualifications Experience: 2–5 years of progressive experience in procurement, purchasing, or supply chain roles (prior experience in an educational institution or multinational corporate setting is highly preferred). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Finance, or a related field. Technical Skills: Proficiency in ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) and strong advanced Excel skills for data analysis. Language & Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to negotiate firmly yet professionally with suppliers and internal stakeholders. Soft Skills: Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, high ethical standards, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment with strict deadlines.

Secure, analyse and evaluate economic, competitive and market information relevant to assigned territories. Established travel industry relationships within the Southeast US and/or Spanish-speaking Latin American markets. The Role: This role is the Integrated Test, Evaluation and Acceptance (ITEA) and Trials Engineer, who is responsible for assigned OMNIA ITEA and Trials activities on behalf of the Configuring Service. Reporting: This position reports directly to the ITEA & Trials Lead Engineer. Job Description: As a member of the Integration, Test, Evaluation, and Acceptance (ITEA) team, you will contribute to the rigorous testing, verification, and validation of new and updated Products, Services, and Systems (PSS). Working under the guidance of the ITEA Lead, your efforts will support the smooth transition of capabilities into the ACTS service, ensuring alignment with Defence architectural standards, safety requirements, and interoperability goals. You will assist in the planning, coordination, and execution of structured testing and trials as part of the Verification, Trial, and Experimentation Plan (VTEP). Your work will help confirm that solutions meet defined capability and integration requirements. This role offers the opportunity to work within advanced test environments and collaborate with engineering, acquisition, and operational teams across Defence. You will play an important part in validating capability performance, supporting system interoperability, and ensuring readiness for service across next-generation simulation training systems. Ensure access to and configuration of engineering information and test evidence across the PSS lifecycle. Validate PSS against ISO 44001-aligned acquisition and supply chain management principles. Skills: Required: Degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Defence Technology, or a related discipline. Experience in Test & Evaluation, System Integration, or Trials Engineering in a Defence, or similar environment. Demonstrated experience in executing trials. Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and cooperatively in a distributed team Good communication and teamwork skills Knowledge and confidence in technical publications Combined Arms Tactical Trainer (CATT) Virtual Battlespace (VBS), Tactical Engagement Simulation (TES), Command and Staff Trainer (CAST) Combined Arms Virtual Dismounted (CAV-D)(V). Understanding of the Strategic Defence Review (SDR 2025) Desirable: Experience with open training and simulation standards: High-Level Architecture (HLA) Distributed Interactive Simulation (DIS) UCATT, MILES, or similar systems Knowledge of CT systems, mission training tools, and synthetic environments. Familiarity with the UK MOD Land Industrial Strategy, acquisition lifecycle, and ITEA governance models (e.g. Knowledge in Defence (KiD), Defence Equipment and Support processes (DE&S). Experience with Defence architectural compliance (e.g. GBA, GSA, GVA) and capability development frameworks, or equivalent. Postgraduate qualifications or certification in Systems Engineering (e.g., INCOSE), Test & Evaluation, or Program Management. Personal Attributes: We are looking for individuals who want to serve. You’ll have a mission focus, and the enthusiasm and drive to ‘get things done’.
